pages.title: Dairy
pages.text: Milk, cheese, yogurt, and other dairy-based foods.$(br2)$(italic)No individual penalty for low Dairy.$()$(br2)$(c:#52c252)$(bold)Bonus (all groups above 75%):$()$()$(br2)$(li)Health Boost I$(li)Regeneration I$(br2)The hardest bar to fill in vanilla. $(thing)Milk buckets$() count — keep a cow farm running.

pages.title: Dairy
pages.text: Food mods change this completely. Cheese, yogurt, butter, and fresh milk from mods like Herbs and Harvest, Croptopia, and Pam's HarvestCraft all count.$(br2)$(italic)If dairy feels impossible to fill — install a food mod.$()
